findings.evidence: docs/internal/product/architecture.md:48,73-75 and docs/internal/standards/contracts.md:24-26 require seams in oqueue-core, while crates/oqueue-crypto/src/providers.rs:16,85 and src/entropy.rs:50 define public traits in oqueue-crypto; ADR-0051 and ADR-0053 explicitly choose this exception, but no standard or architecture amendment records it.
findings.summary: M8 publishes cross-crate seam traits from oqueue-crypto despite the architecture and contracts standards requiring every seam to live in oqueue-core.
